name: @modulex/claude-desktop
description: ModuleX Game Studio extension for Claude Desktop (MCPB): a stdio bridge to the local Studio MCP surface.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/bridge.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=bundle/server/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node scripts/build-manifest.mjs && mcpb validate bundle/manifest.json && mcpb pack bundle dist/modulex-game-studio.mcpb
